vignette: A 60-year-old man develops a resting tremor of the right hand that disappears when he reaches for a cup, with small handwriting and reduced arm swing on the right. His face is expressionless.
stem: Which structure has degenerated, and on which side?
explanation: Asymmetric parkinsonism reflects dopamine loss in the substantia nigra contralateral to the affected limbs, because each basal ganglia loop acts on the opposite body through the crossed corticospinal projection.
